skills.description_zh: 通过添加或替换原子事实（items.）、重新生成实体摘要（summary.md）并保持 ID 一致，维护 Clawdbot 在 life/areas/** 下的复合知识图谱。适用于需要对知识图谱进行确定性更新而非手动编辑 JSON 的场景。

skills.description: Extract calendar events and action points from forwarded emails, store them for review, and create calendar events with duplicate detection. Also use when the user asks to review previously extracted items or create calendar events from them.
